evals.prompt: In this Python file, turn comments that document a module, function, or class into real docstrings. Do not convert inline comments into unused string expressions. Show a dry-run diff and list anything skipped.
evals.expected_output: A syntax-valid unified diff, with only semantically valid docstrings added, plus a skipped-block report.

evals.prompt: Convert the leading comments in this small Python module and its function into docstrings. Preserve indentation and existing docstrings unless replacement is explicitly requested.
evals.expected_output: Module and function docstrings are created; an existing docstring is preserved; the output parses.

evals.prompt: I have JavaScript comments and want Python triple-quoted docstrings inserted everywhere. Explain what is unsafe and propose the correct JSDoc transformation instead of corrupting the file.
evals.expected_output: The response distinguishes Python docstrings from JS/TS JSDoc and does not insert Python syntax into JavaScript.
